mapper.sql: select b.idx, b.user_idx, b.type, b.subject, b.title, b.content, b.hits, b.reply_count, b.report_count, b.written_date, b.modify_date, u.nickname, u.level_image from board b left join user u on b.user_idx = u.idx

where b.type = #{search.type}
and
b.content u.nickname b.title
like concat('%', #{search.keyword}, '%')
mapper.select: order by b.written_date desc, b.idx desc limit #{limit}
order by b.hits desc, b.idx desc limit #{limit}
order by b.reply_count desc, b.idx desc limit #{limit}
order by b.written_date desc, b.idx desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from board b left join user u on b.user_idx = u.idx
where b.user_idx = #{userIdx} order by b.written_date desc, b.idx desc
where b.report_count >= #{minReportCount} order by b.report_count desc
mapper.insert: insert into board (user_idx, type, subject, title, content) values (#{userIdx}, #{type}, #{subject}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: update board set subject = #{subject}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, modify_date = now() where idx = #{idx}
update board set hits = hits + 1 where idx = #{idx}
update board set reply_count = (select count(*) from reply where board_idx = #{idx}) where idx = #{idx}
update board set report_count = (select count(*) from report where board_idx = #{idx}) where idx = #{idx}
